title: Moving a live care platform off Salesforce with zero data loss
tagline: Rebuilt the core service-validation logic in Django and PostgreSQL, then led scripted migrations of ~8,000 staging and ~14,000 production records through a dry-run comparison and 5+ validation stages.
seoDescription: Rebuilt core service-validation logic in Django and PostgreSQL, then migrated ~14,000 production records off Salesforce with zero data loss.
context: A live care-sector platform used by 50+ organizations, 300+ clinicians and 2,000+ users, matching support workers to clients by skill, location and availability. Its live operations depended on Salesforce.
challenge: The platform's live operations depended on Salesforce. Moving them onto the in-house Django and PostgreSQL system meant rebuilding the core service-validation logic and moving live data across without duplicating or losing a record.
The migration had to be planned and executed together with the client's Salesforce developer.

approach.title: Rebuild the core service-validation logic
approach.text: Rebuilt the core service-validation logic from scratch in the in-house Django and PostgreSQL system, so live operations no longer depended on Salesforce.

approach.title: Plan it with the client's Salesforce developer
approach.text: Planned and executed the migration in partnership with the client's Salesforce developer.

approach.title: Dry-run every migration first
approach.text: Ran each scripted migration through a custom dry-run comparison script before real data moved.

approach.title: Validate in 5+ stages
approach.text: Passed records through 5+ validation stages designed to block duplicates.

approach.title: Migrate in two scripted runs
approach.text: Migrated ~8,000 records to staging and ~14,000 to production.

outcome: Live operations now run on the in-house Django and PostgreSQL system, with no dependency on Salesforce.
~14,000 production records migrated with zero data loss.
